programme_detail_official.description: Western Sydney University's Spring Release research scholarships support doctoral candidates commencing in Quarter 1 2027. Scholarships include a stipend of AUD 38,707 per annum for three years together with tuition fees covered by the Australian Government Research Training Program, and they explicitly exclude travel costs, visa costs and relocation expenses. Domestic applicants, and international applicants who have completed or are completing an MPhil or MRes at Western Sydney University, may apply, provided they can be onshore in Australia at commencement. Applications opened on 18 September 2026 and close at 11.59pm AEDT on Sunday 18 October 2026, and every applicant must submit the Standardised Applicant CV with their application.
